parameters.apprise_url_plus: azure://${ customer_secrets.{{ params.source_secret }} }/${ customer_secrets.{{ params.tenant_secret }} }/${ customer_secrets.{{ params.client_id_secret }} }/${ customer_secrets.{{ params.secret_secret }} }
parameters.description:
`msg-to-office365-email` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your Office 365 destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through [Apprise](https://github.com/caronc/apprise), the open-source notification library, driven entirely by your own stored credentials at no cost. A paid variant ($0.001 per message) delivers to additional Office 365 destinations bound per enrollment.
parameters.summary: Send an email notification to your own Office 365 destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

client_id_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Office 365 client id

secret_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Office 365 secret

source_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Office 365 source

tenant_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Office 365 tenant
